subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: A human-edited work-item file leaves the store valid and queryable, or is rejected with a named defect — the CLI and engine never silently discard a human edit
rationale: files are the product (J4); silent loss would break the "just files" promise
fit_criterion: after a valid hand-edit, reads reflect it and the kit stays green; an invalid hand-edit yields a named defect, not corruption
